gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: 'DSXS' container: 256-byte header (ASCII 'Pokemon Diamond', 'Full Game with Events', 'Missing Eigikan Acreus') and a gzip member holding the 512 KiB raw save

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-dsxs.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 524288 --stem 'Pokemon - Diamond Version (Europe) (Rev 5)' --out DIR: gunzips the save from the DSXS container; fits it to the 524288-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file

desmume.detail: CONTINUE: PLAYER JOE, TIME 314:55, BADGES 8, POKéDEX 493 (run in the Diamond (Europe) (Rev 5) image, game code ADAE, which the USA release shares)

melonds.detail: "A communication error has occurred" ("... you will be returned to wherever you last saved") instead of the CONTINUE panel, then a white screen; melonDS 0.9.3 does the same with its own Pearl save from this corpus, so it is the core (no BIOS or firmware here, FreeBIOS), not this save

note: Release: Diamond/Pearl layout, English; Diamond from the version that caught the player's own Pokemon (origin game in the decrypted Pokemon data, OT matching the trainer) and the DSXS header ("Pokemon Diamond"). The library's image of this game code is the Pokemon - Diamond Version (Europe) (Rev 5) release; the save was run in it, since both releases share the game code.
